title: Maximize Your Ad Spend with Facebook Lookalike Audiences | Brolik - A Marketing Agency

facts.fact: The article cites an estimate that advertisers will spend $58.11 billion on Facebook ads in 2022 alone.
facts.quote: an estimated $58.11 billion to be spent by advertisers this year on Facebook ads alone

facts.fact: Facebook's Customer Value Audiences let advertisers indicate a customer's value to their business by adding lifetime spend or another ranking.
facts.quote: With these, you can indicate a customer’s value to your business by adding their lifetime spend or some other ranking.

facts.fact: The article defines first-party data as customer information a business collects and owns itself that a user voluntarily provides, such as an email list.
facts.quote: the customer information you collect and own yourself that a user voluntarily provides, like an email list

facts.fact: With Facebook's lookalike audience targeting, an advertiser provides a customer list and Facebook builds an audience of similar people to show ads to.
facts.quote: you can provide Facebook with a list of customers and they will work to find the attributes of that audience, then build an audience of similar people
